owner: TBD — assign accountable model owner (default: Data Engineering, credit-scoring)
training_period: synthetic dataset, no calendar period (generate_dummy_data.py, seed=42)
known_limitations: Target is banded directly from the synthetic payment_history_score, so this model is largely redundant with CreditScorePredictor.
The rules layer also derives a risk band from the score, duplicating this output.
Reported F1 measures fit to a synthetic label, not real risk discrimination.

validation.method: random 80/20 holdout, stratified on risk (not out-of-time)
validation.value: not_recorded_here (logged to MLflow at each run)

notes: Reference/demo model. Redundancy with the score model is a known architecture gap (Gap 6).
